# MM-P1-L2-HT03-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-HT03

Scope
- Defines required lubrication and quench-related fluid controls for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03). Applicable to maintenance staff performing routine lubrication, fluid top-up, and quench system verification. See SOP-P1-L2-01, SOP-P1-L2-02, SOP-P1-L2-03 for operating and safety procedures.

Tools
- Manufacturer-approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-465.  
- Clean dispensing pump compatible with CFW-LUB-465.  
- Lint-free wipes and containment tray.  
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P1-L2-02.

Procedure
- Isolate system and follow lockout/tagout per SOP-P1-L2-01 before accessing lubrication points.  
- Confirm lubricant identity visually and by label; use only CFW-LUB-465. Replace contaminated reservoirs with fresh CFW-LUB-465.  
- Clean fill ports with lint-free wipes; use containment tray to prevent spills. Dispense lubricant with approved pump until normal sight-glass level is reached. Do not mix lubricants.  
- Inspect delivery lines and fittings for wear, contamination, and proper seating. Replace or repair per SOP-P1-L2-03 if any defect is found.  
- Verify quench system timers and interlocks in coordination with operations. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 24 seconds. Document verification results and return system to service per SOP-P1-L2-01.

Acceptance criteria
- All lubrication points contain only CFW-LUB-465 and show no visible contamination.  
- No leaks or drips from fittings or lines after pressurization test per SOP-P1-L2-03.  
- Quench delay verified at or below the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 24 seconds.  
- Maintenance record updated with lubricant batch/lot, technician initials, and referenced SOPs: SOP-P1-L2-01, SOP-P1-L2-02, SOP-P1-L2-03.
